_comment: Si Math AI production deployment configuration.
THIS FILE CONTAINS NO SECRETS AND MUST NEVER CONTAIN ANY.
Everything here is already public: the Supabase project ref appears in every
client bundle, and the domain is the site itself.
Secrets are read from environment variables at run time, never from disk:
SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN  - required to deploy (Supabase personal access token)
SUPABASE_TEST_JWT      - optional, enables authenticated smoke tests
Any value below can be overridden by an environment variable of the same
